title: ModTheSpire2
description:
A pre-launch mod selector and in-game companion manager for Slay the Spire 2.

GitHub:
https://github.com/grassdog0/MTS2

Features:
- Native Windows launcher with no extra runtime install.
- Choose vanilla or selected mods before the game starts.
- Dependency-aware mod list: dependent mods are shown under required mods and cannot be selected until dependencies are selected.
- Compatible with standard mod JSON files, Workshop mod_manifest.json layouts, legacy pck_name manifests, malformed payload-backed manifests, and explicit-id sidecar manifests.
- Custom load order with Move Up, Move Down, numeric order entry, Save Order, Reset Order, and named order profiles.
- Saved enabled-mod selections, so a one-time Vanilla launch does not erase your normal mod setup.
- In-game ModTheSpire2 management button on the game's Mod Settings page.
- Clean in-game restart helper: close the current game and reopen the launcher to change enabled mods or profiles.
- Whole-mod changes for DLL/PCK/UI/gameplay/unknown mods are handled through the launcher/restart flow.
- Safe Close and Open Launcher flow to avoid running two game instances at once.
- settings.save backups before ModTheSpire2 writes mod settings.

Important:
Steam Workshop cannot change your Steam launch options automatically. To show ModTheSpire2 every time you press Play, set your Slay the Spire 2 launch option to:

"<path to ModTheSpire2Launcher.exe>" -- %command%

Keep %command% exactly as written. Do not replace or remove it. If the game needs extra launch arguments, add them after %command%. Example:

"<path to ModTheSpire2Launcher.exe>" -- %command% --rendering-driver opengl3

The in-game Close and Open Launcher dialog includes a copy button for the base launch option.

- Kept dependency-aware launcher ordering and selection.
- Kept custom load order saving, numeric order entry, and named order profiles.
- Kept saved enabled-mod selections separate from one-time Vanilla launch.
- Kept compatibility for Workshop mods that use mod_manifest.json, including Act 4 Heart / Act4Heart.

- Kept launcher self-tests and package verification for load order, dependencies, saved enabled selections, and manifest compatibility.
